mapper.select: SELECT room_no FROM chat_room WHERE user_a = #{userA} AND user_b = #{userB}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (user_a, user_b) VALUES (#{userA}, #{userB}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE room_no = room_no
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN user_a = #{usernum} THEN user_b ELSE user_a END FROM chat_room WHERE room_no = #{roomNo} AND #{usernum} IN (user_a, user_b)

SELECT r.room_no, u.usernum AS partner_usernum, u.name AS partner_name, u.team AS partner_team, u.level AS partner_level, (SELECT m.content FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no ORDER BY m.message_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, DATE_FORMAT(r.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no AND m.sender_usernum != #{usernum} AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count FROM chat_room r JOIN user u ON u.usernum = CASE WHEN r.user_a = #{usernum} THEN r.user_b ELSE r.user_a END WHERE #{usernum} IN (r.user_a, r.user_b) ORDER BY COALESCE(r.last_message_at, r.created_at) DESC
SELECT usernum, name, team, level FROM user WHERE usernum != #{usernum} AND user_status = '재직' ORDER BY team, level_num, name

SELECT message_no, room_no, sender_usernum, content, DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS sent_at, DATE_FORMAT(read_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS read_at FROM chat_message WHERE room_no = #{roomNo} ORDER BY message_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_no, sender_usernum, content) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{senderUsernum}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT message_no, room_no, sender_usernum, content, DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS sent_at, DATE_FORMAT(read_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS read_at FROM chat_message WHERE message_no = #{messageNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE room_no = #{roomNo}
